definitions.gold_varying: group varies in n_lost or invalid
definitions.nongold_varying: group varies in n_nongold_after, potentially alongside other terms
definitions.nongold_only_varying: the nongold count varies while n_lost and invalid agree; tokens may vary
definitions.token_only_varying: only retained token cost varies under v3; Task 11 defined this without nongold count
definitions.zero_std: population standard deviation exactly zero; informative requires > 1e-9
